scope: Independent review of the parent Python/common graph/CLI implementation followed by user-authorized fixes delegated by the parent. This is not a user-local-agent review.

findings.observed_before: C++20 export declarations disappear in ordinary cursor-tree walks
findings.resolution: Use clang_indexTranslationUnit declaration/reference callbacks; test real module BMI imports.

findings.observed_before: Clang18 assigns equal USRs to distinct constrained function templates
findings.resolution: Use canonical template declaration identity and full declaration signature; preserve explicit specializations separately.

findings.observed_before: x=A(); x=42; x.m() incorrectly resolved to A.m
findings.resolution: Invalidate repeated/unknown instance writes; no resolved method edge for the counterexample.

findings.observed_before: Reassigned function name still resolved to its earlier declaration
findings.resolution: Mark rebound callable/import bindings unresolved, including global/nonlocal writes.

findings.observed_before: Lambda and exception-handler names resolved to a same-named module function
findings.resolution: Create lambda/comprehension scopes and register handler bindings.

findings.observed_before: x:A=B(); x.m() incorrectly resolved to A.m
findings.resolution: Keep annotation type_usage, infer the observed constructor B only; annotations alone prove no runtime type.

findings.observed_before: Parameter bindings shadowed default expressions and annotations
findings.resolution: Evaluate defaults in enclosing scope; annotation scope includes type parameters without ordinary parameters.

findings.observed_before: Relative import beyond the package root was converted to an absolute import
findings.resolution: Reject excess relative levels with explicit diagnostic; do not fabricate a call target.

findings.observed_before: ast.parse accepted module return, bad nonlocal, duplicate arguments and return in except* as complete code
findings.resolution: Compile AST without executing code to check scope legality. Repair the normal fixture and retain forbidden except* return as a negative case.
Add branch assignment, property, monkey patch, factory result, comprehension iterable, filename-order inheritance and UTF8 diagnostic cases.

findings.observed_before: Duplicate diagnostic injection increased error rows from one to two
findings.resolution: Reported to parent; parent implemented deduplication. Latest shared graph suite passes.

commands.command: ../tools/pixi run --locked -e modern python -m pytest tests/modern_indexers/test_python_indexer.py tests/modern_indexers/test_cpp_indexer.py tests/modern_indexers/test_graph.py -q --tb=short --junitxml=build/modern-indexers/python-cpp-review-results.xml

limits: No GUI, cross-OS or full C++/Python language-specification proof is implied.
Python remains a conservative static profile: uncertain dynamic bindings are diagnosed rather than assigned invented call targets.
C++ module BMI generation is explicit and must match Clang18.1.8.
The parent may subsequently change integration files; these hashes identify this reviewed working-tree snapshot.
